text.finding: On the standard all-IMPROVE model the All-Addis intercept falls with k for every baseline: from k = 2 to k = 20 spline goes -0.12 → -1.64 µg/m³ and VIBES 87 -0.32 → -6.98, the minus-LABE1 banks like VIBES 87. Held-out IMPROVE R² vs TOR plateaus by k ≈ 8–11 (spline 0.66 at k = 8, 0.69 at k = 25), so the standard validation cannot tell k = 11 from k = 25. Smoke-like IMPROVE filters go to about −0.3 of their mean HIPS/10 and level off by k ≈ 7, for spline and VIBES alike. Their own TOR-vs-HIPS line (no FTIR) crosses lower still, at -0.72 (high OC/EC) and -0.75 (smoke cohort) of the same mean, because TOR reads low against HIPS in smoke (median Fabs/TOR EC 7.8 against 9.6 network-wide): the IMPROVE smoke offset is a reference gap the models partly inherit. The further VIBES drift at Addis has no IMPROVE counterpart.
